public_rationale: This forecast has no deadline. It says AI-made false websites and fake images are 'with us forever'. Evidence up to the evaluation date fits it. NewsGuard's count of AI content-farm sites rose from 966 in mid-2024 to 3,749 by June 2026. That shows growth, not removal. But persistence so far cannot confirm a 'forever' forecast. No event has shown such content was largely eliminated, which would have contradicted it early. So it stays open.
limitations: NewsGuard counts sites it finds, not all AI content.
No measurement of fake AI images in Google Images was found.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI-generated falsehoods and fake images polluting the web will not go away.

statement.excerpt: This stuff — websites that state falsehoods because an AI hallucinated, or fake pictures of mushrooms and dogs that now dominate Google Images — is not going away.

from_speaker: websites that state falsehoods because an AI hallucinated
fake pictures of mushrooms and dogs that now dominate Google Images
our_interpretation: Forecast with no deadline: AI-generated false websites and fake AI images on the web, including in Google Images, will persist and will not be largely removed.
Because 'forever' has no end date, the forecast cannot be confirmed for good on any date. It could be contradicted early if this content were shown to be largely eliminated.
criteria.support_condition: Over time, credible measurements keep showing AI-hallucinated falsehood sites and fake AI images remaining widespread on the web and in image search.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible measurement shows AI-generated false websites and fake AI images have been largely removed from the web and Google Images, for example through effective detection and filtering.
